::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 277,737 people lived in County Galway, up 7.6% on 2016. It had the third largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 63% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Galway was €1,637, the 4th highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Galway

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Galway was €29,807, the 9th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Galway was €384,000, the 6th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 5.3 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Galway, the 12th highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 28% of households in County Galway rented their home, the 8th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 19% of people living in County Galway were born outside Ireland, the 7th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 49% of people aged 3 and over in County Galway said they could speak Irish, the highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 34% of people at work in County Galway worked from home for at least part of the week, the 6th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 74% of people travelling to work in County Galway went by car, the 22nd highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Galway live more than 1.9 km by road from a GP, the 16th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Galway live more than 19.4 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 16th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 9.7% of County Galway in 2021, the 18th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
